summary: Eni S.p.A. filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) reporting open-market buyback executions on Euronext Milan for 2-6 November 2026: 4,455,629 shares, 0.15% of share capital, at a weighted average of €25.8100 for €114,999,935.11, under the second tranche approved at the 6 May 2026 shareholders' meeting for supplemental shareholder remuneration. Cumulative programme purchases since 8 May 2026 total 97,764,152 shares (3.23%) for €2,284,915,170.15; treasury now 184,592,259 shares, 6.10%. No advisor named. Watch execution pace versus the tranche cap.
